model_annotation: The figure contains two line plots showing training rewards as a function of training steps for two methods on an easy training set (top) and a hard training set (bottom). In both plots, the x-axis is labeled “Steps,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 500 with tick marks at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. In both plots, the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale; in the top plot it spans approximately 0.0 to 0.4 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4, and in the bottom plot it spans approximately 0.0 to 0.2 with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. In the “Easy Training Set” plot, a blue solid line (Llama-On-Policy-Easy) starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to about 0.25 by around 100 steps, then fluctuates around roughly 0.30–0.36 through the remainder, ending near about 0.35–0.36 at step 500; a red solid line (Llama-LUFFY-Easy) starts near 0.0, increases to about 0.22–0.24 by around 100 steps, continues upward with fluctuations, and ends near about 0.40 at step 500. In the “Hard Training Set” plot, a blue solid line (Llama-On-Policy-Hard) begins around 0.02–0.03 at step 0, declines toward 0.0 by roughly 80–100 steps, and remains near 0.0 through step 500; a red solid line (Llama-LUFFY-Hard) starts near 0.0, rises to about 0.10 by around 50–70 steps, continues increasing with small oscillations to around 0.14–0.16 by about 200–300 steps, and ends near about 0.20 at step 500.
